description: Popular tags: GET /api/tags now runs one COUNT query per tag (N+1) on a public, uncached endpoint, so its cost grows with every tag ever created.
notes: FM-16 (performance and cost at scale). getPopularTags loads every tag, then runs one COUNT join query per tag inside the loop: an N+1 on the public, unauthenticated, uncached tags endpoint that every home page load calls, growing with the number of tags ever created (tags are never deleted). Severity important: FM-16 and the Argus performance threshold grade a per-row query on a hot path, growing without bound, as important. Fix: a single grouped query (JOIN article_tags and article_models, GROUP BY tag, HAVING COUNT > 0, ORDER BY COUNT DESC). Filtering soft-deleted articles and keeping getAllTags for its existing test are correct.
